summary: Keep unauthenticated MCP HTTP listeners loopback-only, validate live MovieGlu configuration at request time, and preserve local reads when live access is unavailable.
reason: A wildcard listener exposes credential-backed tools to network peers, while request-time configuration checks let auto and local modes use synced SQLite data without hiding real provider HTTP errors.
validated_outcome: Regression tests pin the loopback listener, typed live-configuration validation, exact film/date scoping across read-through and explicit sync records, local discovery with an explicit booking limitation, and the purchase-confirmation API's HH:MM time contract.
